record.one_liner: Time tracking, expenses, invoicing and project management SaaS with a REST API v2.
record.auth_notes: Personal Access Tokens (sent in Authorization header with Harvest-Account-Id) plus OAuth2 applications registered in the Harvest ID Developers section.
record.access_notes: Harvest support says API access is included for all accounts, including free and trial accounts. critic: confirmed.
record.api_notes: REST API v2 with GET, POST, PATCH and DELETE across time, expenses, projects and related objects.
record.blocker_notes: critic: mcp community -> official, Harvest Help Center documents a vendor-hosted remote MCP server at api.harvestapp.com/mcp.

evidence.quote: A Personal Access Token which is tied directly to you and is the quickest way to start playing around with the API.
Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.
Your Harvest subscription includes API access for all accounts (including free and trial accounts) which can be used to manage your Harvest account.
The Harvest V2 API is a REST API that allows you to interact with your Harvest account programmatically.
Harvest requires applications to authenticate all requests with OAuth2 or Personal Access Tokens.
Set the Remote MCP server URL to: https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp
